Rest areas and some practical advice
The desk is glad to help before opening
Travelers with pets should check in with the Companion Animal Travel Desk early so we can help make the trip calmer and smoother. This notice covers the basic steps that matter most for animal travel, from paperwork to comfort on the day of departure.

Please keep your pet's health and travel documents ready, and make sure the carrier is secure, clean, and easy to handle. If you are bringing a rabbit, <<FACT F082>> Staff can also help you think through feeding, water, and rest needs, since safety takes priority over speed in every journey. Care plans are adjusted to fit the animal's species, temperament, and comfort, so a little preparation goes a long way.

If your travel plans change, let us know as soon as you can so we can update the record and help avoid stress at the airport. A calm departure starts with clear details, gentle handling, and a carrier that feels familiar to your pet. Whether you are traveling with Peanut or another companion, our team is ready to help you keep things simple and steady.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you travel.
